notes: Only 4 searches used; the main NHS helping-others page was returned as a summary, so detailed claims (shopping, GP on behalf, carer wellbeing, Mind named) could not be confirmed and were marked unsupported. c03/c10 and c05-c08 duplicate c01-c03; consider merging. NHS 111 option 2 replaced earlier regional lines from 1 April 2026 per one trust page; availability and wording may vary by area (Wales/Scotland differ), so keep 'mental health option' phrasing and avoid 'option 2' being universal. 'Encouraging the person' phrasing in c13 reads as an instruction; reworded.
